summary: Satellos Bioscience filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that the USPTO granted U.S. Patent No. 12,747,245, a composition-of-matter patent covering forazapadin, its lead AAK1-inhibitor candidate, plus a broader class of compounds. Protection runs through Sept. 6, 2044, with potential patent term extension after U.S. approval. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is involved; the item is an ordinary IP milestone for a clinical-stage issuer listed on Nasdaq and TSX, not a special situation, with no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
